Policy · Last updated August 11, 2026

Acceptable use

Review status

Draft for owner and qualified legal review before public launch.

Safe participation

Do not use Kéire services for malware, credential theft, harassment, fraud, impersonation, spam, unauthorized access, privacy violations, or infringement.

Package safety

Packages may not contain traversal paths, links, device files, undeclared payloads, decompression bombs, hidden executables, install scripts, private keys, or content designed to bypass validation.

Moderation

Reports are rate-limited and audited. Staff may request changes, hide reviews, reject submissions, delist content, suspend access, or revoke unsafe versions. Appeals and copyright workflows require finalized operational policy before launch.
